picks.name: Various Artists
picks.bio: "Endangered Species Vol. 2" (September 4, 2026) is Dark Entries' second archival dig into extinct/out-of-print underground music -- eleven specimens now preserved on vinyl, including a previously unreleased male vocal demo of Alexander Robotnick's "I Wanna Believe" and "Bastards" by Dwayne R. Goettel and cEvin Key (Skinny Puppy).
picks.why_listen: A genuinely new document of lost cold wave, industrial and post-punk-adjacent electronic music -- the Robotnick demo and Goettel/Key track alone are worth digging into for sample-hunting or set-opener texture.

picks.name: Thrill
picks.source_note: New release on Kalahari Oyster Cult.
picks.bio: Will Howard christening a new alias on his Kalahari debut. "Smoke Fuelled Fantasies" (June 26, 2026, cat. OYSTER78) is a four-track EP -- The Voices, Down The Burrow, Globelite, Day Dreamer.
picks.why_listen: A fresh alias worth tracking from day one -- energetic house/techno that fits well alongside the label's other 2026 debutants you've already featured (Michelle).

picks.name: Nectar, Succulent
picks.source_note: New release on Kalahari Oyster Cult (Mineral archival series).
picks.bio: "MINERAL11" (May 21, 2026) is a two-track split 12" -- "Mercurial Drums" by Nectar and "The Nature of Things" by Succulent -- part of Kalahari Oyster Cult's Mineral series surfacing small, obscure original runs, this time from Grayhound Recordings, a San Francisco imprint founded in 1998.
picks.why_listen: Archival digging with real dancefloor use -- rare material resurfaced specifically because it still works today, not just for nostalgia.
